description: CreateDatabase(path, dbLangGeneral, dbVersion120). T3(n LONG) with 3 rows and T600(n LONG, t TEXT(60)) with 600 rows (t a 50-character text), no index, made by DDL and INSERT; the Database closed and the file reopened with OpenDatabase (read/write) in the same engine. The session's first recordset: a snapshot over T3, its Bookmark at the first row and after Move 1; closed; then a snapshot over T3, its first Bookmark. Asks what sets the first recordset's bookmark base: the table's size, the recordset type, or a reopened file.
